transcript_raw:
Kickoff call -- Solace Health -- June 25, 2026
Attendees: Marcus Webb (Solace Health, Director of Ops), Vasu (Onboarding)
Vasu: Let's start with where things stand on your side. Walk me through your current data situation.
Marcus: Our data is clean, we audited it ourselves before this call. You shouldn't run into any issues there.
Vasu: Good to hear, that'll speed things up. Any recent changes to your systems we should know about?
Marcus: We did migrate about a third of our records over from our old CRM last quarter, but the rest is untouched.
Vasu: Understood. Who else from your side should be looped in besides you?
Marcus: It's mostly just me for now, but our compliance lead, Renata Alves, will need to sign off before anything goes live, given we're in healthcare.
Vasu: Got it, I'll make sure compliance sign-off is built into the go-live step.
Marcus: Appreciate that. We're hoping to be live within four weeks if possible, we have an internal deadline tied to a board update.
Vasu: Four weeks is tight but let's see how the early steps go before committing to that.
Marcus: Fair enough. One more thing, we use Salesforce for CRM and our team is fully remote, spread across three time zones, so scheduling might take some back and forth.
Vasu: Noted, we'll plan for async-friendly scheduling. Anything else before we wrap up?
Marcus: I think that's it from our side.
Vasu: Great, we'll follow up shortly with next steps.

approval_queue.drafted_content:
Subject: Kickoff Confirmation and Next Steps

Hello,

Thank you for choosing to partner with us. We are excited to begin this journey together. This email serves as a confirmation of our kickoff meeting, where we discussed the scope of our collaboration and outlined the next steps.

As agreed, we will start with the initial phase of the project, focusing on the key deliverables we discussed. Our team will be in touch shortly to schedule our next meeting and ensure everything is on track.

Please feel free to reach out if you have any questions or require further clarification.

Looking forward to a successful partnership.

Best regards,

Vasu
